userFacingDescription:
Desktop browser data controls are valuable but difficult to discover and access in the moment. Desktop FF users who need to manage browsing data in Classic Window require navigating a multi-step flow in Settings to access it. 79K desktop users clear browsing data 793K times every 28 days (10 actions per user) demonstrating that this is a repeat behavior for users with this need.

The opportunity is to bring this capability into the primary browsing experience, reducing friction and improving discoverability for an existing, high-intent behavior. The experiment will validate whether surfacing the Fire Button increases adoption and repeat use, and whether users get greater value from having granular control on what to delete vs the convenience of deleting everything.  In addition, we’ll validate if it will uncover latent demand.
